seoTitle: Inchinvima, Farranfore, Killarney, Co. Kerry, V93R6A2
description:
New to market, this stunning 5-Bedroom Residence at Farranfore, Killarney, Co. Kerry

Grounds & Location
This expansive 255 square metre detached home offers a rare combination of space, privacy, and an ideal location, midway between the vibrant towns of Tralee and Killarney.  
The peaceful countryside property is situated on an impressive C 0.8-acre site with front and back lawns, mature shrubs, and is surrounded and sheltered by trees.  The property has its own private traffic free road to the rivers Maine and Brown Flesk for fishing or enjoying quiet riverbank strolls.
The property benefits from a peaceful countryside setting while remaining exceptionally well connected.  Farranfore (3km) with its railway station, 2 medical centres, large pharmacy, Knockaderry primary school and grocery shops, Kerry Airport (4km), Firies (4km) with its highly rated primary School (which won the prestigious Excellence in Education Award at the 2025 Tech Industry Alliance (TIA) Leaders Awards), Tralee (14km) and Killarney (18km).
A 12.94 square meter detached 2 room building to the rear offers ample storge and a multipurpose room with water and electricity supplies.

The Home
Designed with family living in mind, this light-filled residence boasts:
•	a large kitchen / dining room bathed in natural light 
•	a spacious utility room 
•	Generous sitting room 
•	Downstairs bedroom / play room 
•	Large office ideal for remote work
•	5 well-proportioned 1st floor bedrooms
•	4 bathrooms

•	Utility (3.5m x 1.7m) 
•	Large Family Room (7.5m x 3.5m) with French doors leading on to the rear of the property and an adjoining conservatory (2.5m x 4.8m)
